title: E-SPN-0197: g of the light wall pair from its Landau zero level: E-FRC-0267's chiral slab at L = 8 to 20 in a...
purpose: Experiment E-SPN-0197 in the spin arena: g of the light wall pair from its Landau zero level: E-FRC-0267's chiral slab at L = 8 to 20 in a uniform field in the tangent (0, 1) plane (qa 48, 64, 96), the half gap of the wall-A/wall-B zero-level pair read against the leak delta, testing whether the Pauli coupling kappa_P falls with the leak (chirally protected, $a_w$ second order in delta / Lambda) or tends to a constant (first order).
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
